notes.title: Update
notes.content:
In about a month or so, there will be one last, small update for No Regrets.

This will add a few things that are in NightFall : Achievement information on the title screen and an updated gender selection screen too.

There will be one other important change that will affect everyone (although it is intended for new players)  : On the first run, all achievements will be wiped.  This is due to the ongoing achievement system not working properly straight away, and it's been found that clearing and then syncing fixes the problem (whatever it is).

notes.title: Grendel Fight Update
notes.content:
Aside from fixing a few mysteriously added spelling errors in the Preview section, this update mainly upgrades the Grendel fight near the beginning of the game.

The protagonists' name is displayed correctly in the health bar line.  What happens if you don't do anything is now more in line with WTC 1 now : Missing the "defence" section will now increase Grendel's attack strength.  Whenever it's her turn to attack, if her attack strength is sufficiently high enough, she will launch a super attack.

The initial timer now starts at one second lower than previously too

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
This update is the first of (probably) quite a few updates to No Regrets before the release at the end of June.

All the required backgrounds are now in.  All of the music and most of the sound effects are in as well.

The story has also been expanded in various areas to give a bit more background to the protagonist penchant for rules and regulations and Grendel's desire to recruit the protagonist.

The manga section near the end of the game needs to be done, which will hopefully be of the adult variety.  A few other graphics need to be added as well.

Two new bad endings have been added, as well as a short preview

notes.title: Penultimate update
notes.content:
The first update of the year, and the penultimate one before coming out Early Access - I'm hoping the last update for being in Early Access will be at the end of February/early March.

This update contains :

[list]
[*] Fix for crash at start of the final fight
[*] "Visual novel only" mode or "Visual novel plus fight sequences".  This allows players to just read the story if they don't like the fight sections.  Choosing the "visual novel only" mode does limit the available endings
[*] New character and background graphics added
[*] Fixed some grammatical errors
[/list]

There are now two characters to go and around ten backgrounds along with sound effects.  I'm hoping to get everything done by  the end of March for testing in April, and the chances are good that it's on schedule.

* * *

In other news, WTC 1 will be updated hopefully later in the year (with mainly addition graphics for the Idiot's Guide DLC) along with a story update.

WTC 2 - Part III : NightFall's main story is edging towards being finished, after which all the secret scenes (which will be only available after completing the game once) will be added.  These scenes will add a lot more to the story.

Once that is completed, I'll probably then start writing the last OVN, with the aim of getting both of these out by the end of the near, leaving 2021 to update the last episode of this series.

NightFall may be put into Early Access again - it certainly seemed to work out okay with No Regrets.

notes.title: Last update for the year
notes.content:
This is the last update for the year, and adds character graphics for two people.

The remaining three remaining character graphics will resume next year, along with all the backgrounds.  Hopefully, it will all be done by the end of April.

In other news :

Around 80% of the main story for WTC 2/3 : NIghtFall has been coded.  There is one and a half complete sections needed to go, and then the "secret stories" need to be added.

Fortunately not many new backgrounds or characters need to be added for this, so I hope to get it out well before the end of 2020.  Some backgrounds for this are shared with WTC 3, which is pretty handy.

Finally, one last OVN will probably be written.  This too will share graphics with WTC 3, and may not need much in the way of original backgrounds.

Finally, once these three have been released, I'll start upgrading WTC 3.  The story will certainly need updating, along with gender-specific dialogue.

So, thanks for playing the WTC series (or at least trying the demo), and a merry Christmas and a Happy New Year !

If you have any queries or suggestions, don't be afraid of making a post in the forums

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
This is a fairly big update.

In addition to the text of one gender being completed, this version now incorporates extra accessibility options for those who have trouble reading.

This means that there are now two fonts available (the standard DejaVu Sans and Open Dyslexic).  Textbox transparency, text spacing, line spacing and text size can now be changed too.

Note that these options only affect dialogue and chapter names - menu choices, intro/outro/title sequence videos aren't affected by these options, along with the main menu.

These options will be filtered through to WTC 2 - Part 1, WTC OVN and WTC 0 (the test project) to start with

WTC 1 and WTC 3 will be updated later (WTC 3 also needs a gender-specific update too, but that's another story).

The story is now finalised and won't be changed, unless any unwanted continuity problems are found.

Next will be protagonist graphics and hopefully a few backgrounds.  Protagonist graphics will be added into WTC 2/1, OVN, test program first
